items.name: Specific harmonic fingerprints — the Williams sound
items.description: Several characteristic harmonic moves: (1) the bVI→I "magical" cadence (Db major → C major); (2) modal mixture with lowered 3rd or 7th for ominous effect; (3) Lydian raised 4th for wonder and discover
